content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist position is 11 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed M.Tech in EE/CSE with a CGPA of 8.5 or more, along with 3 years of relevant experience after M.Tech.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sr. Project Scientist post ranges from Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month, plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: You need to apply via email by sending your complete application with all required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Sr. Project Scientist post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section in this article.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Delhi for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is http://ird.iitd.ac.in.
